findings.text: Temporal dead zone: INCOMING_MESSAGES is used at line 14 but declared at line 34. Any call to onMessage before module initialization completes throws ReferenceError.
Temporal dead zone: OUTGOING_MESSAGES is used at line 60 but declared at line 83. Any call to startSendMessage before module initialization completes throws ReferenceError.

Infinite loop risk: if endSendMessage is never called (e.g., exception before it in send.js line 139), the while loop in waitForOutgoingMessages waits forever since the deferred promise never resolves.

Unhandled rejection: if a deferred promise rejects, Promise.all rejects and propagates out of waitForOutgoingMessages, breaking the message emission loop in onMessage and leaving messages stuck in the queue.

0.reason: The module is fully initialized before any external call to onMessage can occur, so the temporal dead zone is not reachable in practice.

1.reason: The module is fully initialized before any external call to startSendMessage can occur, so the temporal dead zone is not reachable in practice.

2.reason: If endSendMessage is not called due to an exception before it in sendMessageAsync, the deferred promise never resolves and waitForOutgoingMessages loops forever, which is a genuine defect.

3.reason: If a deferred promise rejects, Promise.all rejects and propagates out of waitForOutgoingMessages, breaking the message emission loop and leaving messages stuck, which is a genuine defect.
